edits.modify_from: Seed target identities from the incoming positions at the start of the observed interval; for newly covered cubes, use the association with their descending covers.
edits.modify_to: Seed target identities from incoming positions, which are anchors at the preceding decision scene, not coordinates required to appear exactly in the first new frame. If motion has already begun by that frame, associate the displaced candidates jointly with those anchors using their initial displacement and the subsequent observed pair motion. Resolve this initial association consistently with the later trajectory, then propagate the assigned identities through the entire interval. Never snap an identity back to its incoming position merely because another container occupies it. For newly covered cubes, use the association with their descending covers.

revision.refused: No annotation-rule change is committed: its complete-trajectory identity tracking already defines the correct annotations, and the report requests preserving those values. Half-turn exchange and restoration after two observed half-turns are already explicit in the policy prompt. The existing joint signed-angular-advance procedure, settling rules, and updates of every pending target before dispatch remain unchanged rather than being duplicated. No coordinate-path examples or hard-coded endpoints are added, consistent with earlier rounds. No additional persistent fields or subgoal changes are needed; the new clarification addresses association across the observation-interval boundary while preserving successful-lift removal, button updates, and decision-scene holding conditions.
